title: Biduality compatibility from the scalar evaluation square
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, and a separated finite-type $D.k$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $i:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding. Let $w_E,w_L$ be coherent integral dualizing data [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum], and $A,B$ supplied normalized rational Verdier data [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Write $Q_E,Q_L$ for the raw rational localizations, $T$ for integral scalar extension, and $\bar T$ for its rational scalar extension [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Write $D_E=A.\mathrm{dual}$ and $D_L=B.\mathrm{dual}$, and $\beta_K$ for the actual evaluation-transpose integral comparison in the presentations $A.\mathrm{ordinary},B.\mathrm{ordinary}$ [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core]. Assume additionally that $A.\mathrm{symmetry}$ and $B.\mathrm{symmetry}$ are natural in both ambient derived variables. Let $e$ be any Extension from $A$ to $B$ [def-sf-rational-verdier-data] for which the completed rational evaluation square holds: $$\otimes_L(1,e.\mathrm{comparison}_K);\mathrm{ev}_{B,\bar TK}=\bar c^{-1}_{K,D_EK};\bar T(\mathrm{ev}_{A,K});e.\omega.$$ Then its actual bidual maps satisfy $$\bar T(\delta_{A,K});e.\mathrm{comparison}_{D_EK}=\delta_{B,\bar TK};D_L(e.\mathrm{comparison}_K)$$ for every rational $K$. Here $\delta_A,\delta_B$ are the bidual maps in the supplied Datum, hence the localized evaluation transposes [def-sf-integral-verdier-models]; no comparison existence or evaluation conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Naturality makes each supplied signed symmetry uniquely determined by its Koszul model: choose K-flat representatives for both objects and conjugate by the tensor images of the representing isomorphisms. Thus the source and target symmetries commute with the normalized scalar tensorator. On the K-flat models the two maps have identical coefficient multiplication and Koszul sign, since coefficients are in degree zero; model rigidity and completion naturality give the equality on the derived objects.

proof.text: Fix an integral representative K and transpose the given evaluation square in the dual input. The defining formula for delta is precisely evaluation after the signed swap transposed by that adjunction. The symmetry compatibility from the preceding step and naturality of the supplied comparison identify the two transposes with the two displayed composites. The fixed-input tensor-Hom bijection, localized on the scalar Hom groups, is injective, so the composites agree.

proof.text: Substitute A.bidual_integral and B.bidual_integral. These are the specified bidual maps, not an independently chosen anti-equivalence unit. Since every raw rational object has its integral object as representative, the resulting equality proves the claim for every K, including zero objects, identity embeddings and empty X.

theorem evaluation_implies_biduality
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (wL : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E wE) (B : Datum D l hl X L wL)
    (hA : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (A.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (A.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (hB : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      B.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (B.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (B.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ B.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (e : Extension D l hl X E L i wE wL A B)
    (heval : (∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
    (tensor D l hl X L).map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((scalar l X E L i).obj K)) (e.comparison.hom.app (op K))) ≫
      B.evaluation ((scalar l X E L i).obj K) =
    (@rationalTensorScalarComparison l _ E _ _ _ L _ _ _ i X (units D l hl X)).inv.app
        (K, A.dual.obj (op K)) ≫
      (scalar l X E L i).map (A.evaluation K) ≫ e.omega.hom)) :
    (∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
    (scalar l X E L i).map (A.bidual.hom.app K) ≫
      e.comparison.hom.app (op (A.dual.obj (op K))) =
    B.bidual.hom.app ((scalar l X E L i).obj K) ≫
      B.dual.map (e.comparison.hom.app (op K)).op)
